record.summary: The combined card (banked base + t7 trim + rank-4 carrier + output clamp, cholesky-free, three audit rounds) scored 3.974e-8 deployed against the raw host (minus 56 percent, 200 of 200) but +34 percent AGAINST THE TRUE DEPLOYED BASELINE (frozen corrector on the sealed base tapes: 2.958e-8 on the same rows, matching its 2.941e-8 board grade): the frozen learned corrector and the analytic carrier double-remove their shared component.
